jobs.title: Mum’s walking lantern
jobs.description: “It lights the table. Carry it to the garden and it goes dark. I want to take it to the evening gathering.”

evidence.summary: Light reaches 0% under movement; output falls short.
Contact: The exposed metal is aged and dull.
0.04 V from C to D (bench).
0 V from C to D (movement).
6 V from B to C (movement).
0.04 V from B to C (bench).
Switch: The outside looks intact.
Retightened the switch mounting and seated its lever; run under load and movement to check the result.
Light reaches 0% under movement; output falls short.
Replaced Switch. Test the object again.
Light reaches 96% under movement; output stays steady.

jobs.quote: A family favour. Return it by 17:00 if you can.

jobs.title: The little paper theatre
jobs.description: A cardboard street on a music-box drive. The tune races ahead of the figures. Keep it, improve it, or take your time.

evidence.summary: Drum turns at 24 rpm under load (requested 12 ± 1 rpm); melody loses its pace.
C: 48 rpm; D: 24 rpm. Rotation change -24 rpm.
Set Governor collar to 1. Measure motion and test the melody.
C: 24 rpm; D: 12 rpm. Rotation change -12 rpm.
Drum turns at 12 rpm under load (requested 12 ± 1 rpm); melody keeps its pace.

jobs.title: The cracked spare lantern
jobs.description: The casing is ruined, but some internals still work. Recovering a part commits this object to salvage.

jobs.title: Nora’s reading light
jobs.description: “It is bright for a moment, then fades. I read to my nephew after supper. Please test it with the light actually working.”

evidence.summary: Light reaches 53% under load; output falls short.
5.91 V from A to 0 (bench).
5.91 V from A to 0 (load).
2.67 V from C to D (load).
2.67 V from C to D (bench).
Cleaned the mating contact faces; run under load and movement to check the result.
Light reaches 96% under load; output stays steady.

jobs.quote: £18 if restored and checked. Return by Day 2 · 17:00.

jobs.title: Evan’s small desk fan
jobs.description: “It spins here. Press it against the filter and it slows down. The room gets hot when the windows are closed.”

evidence.summary: Airflow reaches 25% under load; output falls short.
3.41 V from D to 0 (bench).
1.49 V from D to 0 (load).
1.54 V from A to 0 (load).
3.44 V from A to 0 (bench).
Replaced 6 V cell pack. Test the object again.
Airflow reaches 89% under load; output stays steady.

jobs.quote: £32 if restored and checked. Return by Day 2 · 17:00.

jobs.title: Nora’s keepsake music box
jobs.description: “The melody sounds wrong. This was my grandmother’s. A new motor would miss the point; I want this one to work.”

evidence.summary: Drum turns at 3.75 rpm under load (requested 15 ± 3 rpm); melody loses its pace.
0: 0 rpm; A: 90 rpm. Rotation change 90 rpm.
0: 0 rpm; A: 90 rpm. Rotation change 90 rpm.
A: 90 rpm; B: 30 rpm. Rotation change -60 rpm.
A: 90 rpm; B: 7.5 rpm. Rotation change -82.5 rpm.
Gear: The outside looks intact.
Replaced Gear. Test the object again.
Drum turns at 15 rpm under load (requested 15 ± 3 rpm); melody keeps its pace.

jobs.quote: £26 if restored and checked. Return by Day 2 · 17:00.

jobs.title: Sam’s winding toy
jobs.description: “On the bench, the melody stops; while driving the figures, the melody stops. I picked this up with my sister. No hurry if you want to try.” I want the figures to turn at 18 rpm, within one rpm.

evidence.summary: Drum turns at 0 rpm under bench (requested 18 ± 1 rpm); melody stops.
A: 90 rpm; 0: 0 rpm. Rotation change -90 rpm.
A: 90 rpm; B: 0 rpm. Rotation change -90 rpm.
Gear: The outside looks intact.
Reseated the gear on its spindle; run under load and movement to check the result.
Drum turns at 0 rpm under load (requested 18 ± 1 rpm); melody stops.
A: 90 rpm; B: 0 rpm. Rotation change -90 rpm.
Replaced Gear. Test the object again.
Drum turns at 15 rpm under load (requested 18 ± 1 rpm); melody loses its pace.
B: 30 rpm; C: 30 rpm. Rotation change 0 rpm.
Set Governor collar to 3. Measure motion and test the melody.
Drum turns at 18 rpm under load (requested 18 ± 1 rpm); melody keeps its pace.

jobs.quote: £22 if restored and checked. Return by Day 4 · 17:00.

jobs.title: The meeting-room fan
jobs.description: “At rest, the airflow falls short; through the grille, the airflow falls short. We are opening the room on Saturday. The fan needs to move air through its grille.”
jobs.quote: £24 if restored and checked. Return by Day 4 · 17:00.

jobs.title: The community room fan
jobs.description: The room is ours on Day 4. A fan that moves air through its grille would let Nora read indoors. This is a shared favour, not paid work.

jobs.title: Evan’s path lantern
jobs.description: “On the shelf, it stays bright; when carried, it goes dark. While working, it stays dim. The garden path is uneven. I need it to stay on when it is carried.”
jobs.quote: £20 if restored and checked. Return by Day 5 · 17:00.
